---
name: Bug report
about: Report a framework, skill, or packaging problem
---

## Problem

Describe expected and actual behavior using fictional or redacted data.

## Environment

AI host/surface/build, OS, Python version if relevant, and framework version.

## Reproduction

Minimal prompt, relevant configuration, and observable result. Do not upload private campaign content, credentials, or purchased sources.

## Validation

Relevant command output or a redacted example.
